validation.readbackResult: Confirmed service-owned HyperBoost and a durable ownership journal before the unexpected-exit boundary.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validation build bound the exact RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00 installation, Balanced and Automatic baseline, admitted full-power adapter, confirmed physical pad absence, and a one-time crash-validation manifest.
The installed Service applied HyperBoost once, confirmed mode 7, finalized durable ownership, and created the private marker without cleanup or manual recovery.
A bounded elevated helper verified and forcibly terminated only the marker-bound OpenBlade Service instance; SCM then started one replacement instance from the same exact validation executable.

Read-only FirmwareSmoke verification confirmed stable Balanced and Automatic state, a retired journal, the expected replacement boundary, and exactly one matching Service recovery attempt and completion.

The first read-only verifier rejected the otherwise complete result because expected post-recovery fan drift was treated as an installed-generation mismatch. Commit 7e47ef6f narrowed that exception to the sole Fans diagnostic; 82 focused tests passed and the same marker then verified without another hardware write.
The private arm, boundary, marker, diagnostics, and verification records remain uncommitted; this annotation retains only bounded hashes, lengths, semantic outcomes, and exact executable provenance.

limitations: This run validates one installed-Service unexpected-exit recovery on the exact RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00 generation, Balanced and Automatic, admitted full-power adapter, and confirmed physical pad absence.
It does not validate sleep/resume recovery; the separate low-power run failed and remains authoritative negative evidence.
Production padless HyperBoost remains disabled while any required lifecycle gate is false.

productionAdmission.reason: Unexpected-exit recovery is validated, but the independent low-power lifecycle gate failed.

notes: FirmwareSmoke verification was read-only and issued no recovery write.
No Razer service was started, stopped, or restored.
Private lifecycle markers, diagnostics, local paths, and service instance identifiers are not committed.
